subject.title: fix(browser): time out Google Docs page exports

question: Should authenticated Google Docs exports fail after a fixed 30-second deadline, accepting that unusually slow but otherwise successful documents will require a retry?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but the selected duration defines user-visible browser-extension failure policy rather than deriving from an existing documented timeout contract.

options.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
options.body: Confirm that promptly releasing a stalled share workflow outweighs allowing longer-running authenticated exports, then rebase and land the focused patch.

options.title: Choose a different bounded policy
options.body: Set an owner-approved duration or retry/feedback policy and update the focused tests and real-flow proof to match.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
recommendation.body: Confirm that promptly releasing a stalled share workflow outweighs allowing longer-running authenticated exports, then rebase and land the focused patch.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely adjacent owner for browser-extension page-share behavior; confidence is limited without complete current-main provenance.
